Doc Aga UX Redesign — Phase 0 mockups (Jakob's Law)
What changes: persistent bottom nav on every screen, every screen has a real URL (Android back works), Tagalog-first labels, 48px buttons / 44px chips, one canonical flow per task.
What stays: the green brand (hsl 142 76% 28%), cream background, 12px radius, Bio-Card and OVR score.
Row 1: the shared shell (farmer + farmhand). Row 2: recording and forms. Row 3: hub screens.

Shell decisions
• Same shell for farmer and farmhand — nav items filter by role (farmhand: no Pera)
• Owner now gets the same 1-tap record buttons the farmhand always had
• Voice training moves from a pulsing floating button into a dismissible Home card
• One FAB only: Doc Aga
• Animal profile: back + ⋮ menu replaces the 5-button stack; all 7 tabs visible as wrapping chips

Recording + forms
• ONE milk sheet for all entry points (FAB, animal chip, operations, farmhand)
• Success swaps content inside the same sheet — no modal-over-modal
• Offline: Save stays enabled; banner explains auto-sync
• Add/Edit animal = one form at /animals/new and /animals/:id/edit; inline field errors replace sequential toasts; Quick/Full is a segmented control, not a switch

Hubs
• Operations segments (Gatas/Pakain/Breeding) are URLs — /operations/milk — so back and deep links work
• 'Iba Pa' is a one-tap grid replacing 4 levels of nested tabs; Marketplace, Orders, Messages and Profile keep the bottom nav when opened
